speaker: gauge
text: This turbine only has three blades. Let's add more!

speaker: fitz
text: More blades catch a bit more wind. But they add weight and cost, for little extra power.

speaker: fitz
text:
Two must spin faster for the same power. That's louder.
And two blades are easy to turn one moment, stiff the next. So turning into the wind, the tower twists.
Three blades balance like a smooth disc.
So three is the sweet spot between power, smoothness and cost.

speaker: gauge
text: Ooh, what else is built weird? Subscribe and let's find out.
